items.en: Ukraine's General Staff says it shot down nearly 60% of Russian jet-powered Geran-4 drones over the past three months
items.nl: Oekraïense Generale Staf: bijna 60% van de Russische straalaangedreven Geran-4-drones in de afgelopen drie maanden neergehaald
items.sEn: In an update on its Telegram channel on 27 October 2026, Ukraine's General Staff said the shoot-down rate of Russia's jet-powered Geran drones is steadily rising.
